hero.headline: Work that already needs doing.
hero.body: Start with a defined responsibility. Give an AI worker the right context, a clear job and a person to answer to.

solutions.headline: Choose a responsibility.
solutions.body: Six practical starting points, based on Audoryn's workforce templates.

items.title: Keep the daily picture current.
items.body: Review connected work context and prepare a concise internal update, with exceptions surfaced for a person.
items.deliverable: A daily brief ready for review

image.alt: A logistics operations floor with a supervisor overseeing the work

items.title: Turn source material into a clear brief.
items.body: Read issues and pull requests, separate observed facts from inference and assemble a technical change brief.

image.alt: Research materials being reviewed at a worktable

items.title: See what needs attention first.
items.body: Review recent messages and prepare a prioritized triage brief for the support team.

items.title: Arrive prepared for the next meeting.
items.body: Review upcoming meetings and relevant prospect context to prepare supervised follow-up.

items.title: Make campaign context easier to use.
items.body: Review recent campaign material and summarize what the team needs to know.

items.title: Stay close to repository work.
items.body: Review repository issues and pull requests to prepare a concise engineering status brief.

solutions.note: Templates create draft roles and jobs. Connections, capabilities, policy and activation remain explicit setup steps.

closing.headline: Start with one useful responsibility.
closing.body: See how the workforce runs, or set up a supervised worker in Audoryn.
